# COLUMN DEFINITIONS
# component_id
#   Short unique identifier for this component.
#   Rules: lowercase
#   Must match the component_id values used in component_concepts.csv.
#   Examples: "female"
# component_name
#   Human-readable label used in reports and output tables.
#   Examples: "Female sex"
# domain
#   OMOP CDM domain to query for this component.
#   Valid values: condition | procedure | drug | measurement | observation
#   The pipeline queries the corresponding OMOP table:
#     condition   → condition_occurrence
#     procedure   → procedure_occurrence
#     drug        → drug_exposure
#     measurement → measurement
#     observation → observation
# lookback_start_day
#   Start of the lookback window relative to the index date (cohort_start_date).
#   Negative = days before index. 0 = index date itself.
#   Examples: -365 (1 year prior)
# lookback_end_day
#   End of the lookback window relative to the index date.
#   -1 = the day before index (for strictly prior events).
#    0 = include events on the index date.
#   Examples: -1 (up to but not including index)
# min_count
#   Minimum number of qualifying records required to count the component as
#   present. Almost always 1.
# points
#   Integer score points assigned when this component is present.
#   Use positive values for risk factors (e.g. 1
#   Use negative values for protective factors (e.g. -1).
# missing_is_negative
#   TRUE  = absence of any qualifying record means the component is absent.
#           This is the default and appropriate for most components.
#   FALSE = used for computed/derived components where a missing value should
#           not be treated as negative (e.g. BMI computed from weight/height).
